Name: Haley Squirrel Girl - Haley Pet
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#9900ff][size=6][u][center]Haley Pet[/center]
[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=5][u]Don't ask just enjoy it.[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]


[size=4][b]Adopt and take care of this cute humanoid creature named Haley, nobody knows where she comes from but she certainly doesn't behave like a person, and the worst thing? She will take up your entire bed and you will probably have to sleep on the floor.
[/b][/size]

[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Features of the mod:
[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i][u]Replace the cat with Haley.[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Erratic behavior.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Some new animations, such as pull a camera out of nowhere and ask 'what is this?'[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Completely silent... (I couldn't find the sound I'd like her to have so she won't make any sound instead).[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Life partner.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Say goodbye to your bed.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Customization options.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list]
